items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline ('protested', 'Nope'). Keep a lively, quick pace; this is a 40-second Short. Chars voices funny cartoon characters: a cheerful, smug talking alarm clock, then a smug, charming France with a light French accent. Short and punchy.
lines: You get one New Year's midnight. Russia gets eleven.
When Kamchatka hits midnight... Kaliningrad's still at two PM.
So how do you run one country on eleven clocks?
In twenty ten, Russia tried deleting two.
By twenty fourteen, both were back.
Trains? Until twenty eighteen, timetables ran on Moscow time.
[cheerful, smug, ticking] Your seven PM train? It's two AM here.
Nope. France has twelve... thanks to islands all over the planet.
[smug, charming French accent, deadpan] Russia is wide. I'm everywhere.
This is Bhoogol. Follow for more Geography Fun Facts.
